_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Wɛl Snake alɔŋ a {width}×{height} kuɔr.
Yin aya wɛl {player_id}. Cɛŋ wɛl: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (ke 'w'/'s'/'a'/'d').
Thiäi: kuɔr tɛk lɔŋ ku tɛk ke dɛl kɛ cɛŋ kuɔr (tɛk lɔŋ {max_turns} kuɔr).

board.current: Kuär in tä thi̱n ɛn täämɛ: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Snake {player_id} cɛ li̱w kɛ ɣöö /ci̱kɛ lät.

outcome.survived_win: Player {player_id} cɛ tëk; nɛy tin kɔ̱ŋ diaal ci li̱w.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Kɛn thɔ̱ɔ̱l diaal cukɛ li̱w kɛɛl.
outcome.outlived: Player cɛ tëk ni̱ kɛn diaal.
outcome.turn_limit: Mi̱ ci̱ pek in ca thöp ɛ mi̱ cɛ cop - min gɔa ni̱ jɛn kä bi̱ ben raar bɛ jiek.
